posts.title: How to migrate Jellyfin from Windows to Docker
posts.description: For a long time, my Jellyfin server was running on Windows, on an Intel NUC . When I moved it to Docker on my new NAS , I wanted to keep my Jellyfin instance as it was, with a proper data migration between the two hosts. The Jellyfin documentation isn’t of much help here: it warns that the internal databases can’t easily be copied or adjusted, and points to a third-party script, Jellyfin-Migrator

posts.title: Exporting a non-exportable private key from the Windows Certificate Store
posts.description: I recently switched laptops while traveling, and I had to migrate a client certificate, used for mTLS, that I had saved in the Windows Certificate Store. Of course, when I imported it initially, I didn’t select “Mark this key as exportable”, and Windows was (logically) refusing to let me export it now.
